sources.source_name: Walt Disney Archives / D23: Disney History
sources.notes: Company history: The Lion King was a hit in 1994; Capital Cities/ABC purchase completed early 1996; Animal Kingdom and Disney Magic cruise ship began operating in 1998. Later history on the same page is not used.

Company archive of the contemporary report. Pentium II and Pentium with MMX drove 1997 processor growth; Celeron and Pentium II Xeon expanded the range in 1998. Fiscal 1998 revenue $26.3 billion and profit $6.1 billion, down from $6.9 billion in 1997. Archive path is modern; facts concern 1996–1998.

sources.source_name: Intel: Record Second Quarter Revenue (company release via Cision)
sources.notes: Company-issued earnings release: second-quarter revenue $8.3 billion, up 23%; record microprocessor and flash-memory unit shipments and strong PC/server demand. Profit growth included substantial investment income, so it is not presented as purely chip operating performance. Stock splits are not treated as returns.
